The derivative is the constant 1/sqrt2, hence integrable. Both integrands are continuous on the compact intervals, so F6 gives bounded Riemann integrability. F7 identifies the left side with its Lebesgue integral, under the CC in step 1.1. [F5, F6, F7, step 1.1]
